note: The eight default tracks every visitor starts with. Slots 1-4 are audio files in this folder: to change one, put the file here and set its "file" (e.g. "tracks/nightfall.mp3") and "name" (shown in the HUD, keep it short). Slots 5-8 are procedural: "proc" 1-4 picks a song that Rive makes live (rive/audio/songs.as: AFTERBURN, MAINFRAME, GLASSHOUSE, FAULTLINE), so they need no file; give one a "file" instead to use a recording. A visitor's own dropped track replaces a slot in their browser only; RESTORE DEFAULT brings this one back.
